text: Yes, a small portion of the forest on this property was cleared in 2023. The clearing affected about 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the asset), which was identified as planted forest (0.4 hectares of *Eucalyptus* species) rather than native forest. The loss was confirmed by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference. However, an additional 0.4 hectares of small patches (under 0.5 ha) were also lost but were not counted as part of the main event due to size thresholds. No native forest was affected.
